rooms.description: Where the owner reads revenue across the online shop and the neighborhood stores, plus which kitchenware item carries the month.

rooms.name: Shop Floor & Online
rooms.description: The counter view of units moving through the storefronts and the web shop, split by channel so staffing follows demand.

rooms.name: Kitchenware Line
rooms.description: The shelf of reusable kitchenware and home storage pieces the shop resells, with the range kept short and easy to explain.

rooms.name: Parts & Packaging
rooms.description: Incoming glass storage sets and shipping boxes tracked by supplier, so restocking happens before the shelf runs thin.

rooms.name: Packing & Shipping
rooms.description: The bench where online orders are wrapped, boxed and handed to carriers, plus the pace the shop packs at each week.

reasoning: Harbor Goods resells finished kitchenware and storage rather than making it, so a neighborhood storefront fits better than a workshop. The rooms cover the money, both sales channels, the shelf itself, restocking and packing.
